title: The Best Tour!
text: My husband and I had such a great time on the White Villages Tour with David that we were excited to book another before we left! This time we went to Merida and visited several Roman ruins. David totally personalized the tour for us. First, he pointed out so many neat places that you could see from the road on the way to Merida. We even stopped at a really nice "truck stop type" place that had locals and authentic breakfasts. title: All the bext of Merida in a single day.
text: An absolutely superb tour to Merida, under the care of our eexcellent driver and guide, David, with a local guide in Merida too. There was time for the Amphitheatre, the Theatre, the crypt and church of St Eulalia, the Termple of Diana, Trajan's arch, the Alcazar, the long Roman bridge, and the circus. We also managed to get round the museum. Many thanks.
author: Peter C
